name: Ba Na Hills and the Golden Bridge
kicker: Hill resort built around the Golden Bridge
summary: Ride the cable car into the hills west of the city and walk the Golden Bridge, the gold curve held out over the valley by two giant stone hands. The basic ticket also covers the French Village and Fantasy Park. Give it a full day, and skip it if the beach and Hoi An already have your days.
getThere: By car from Da Nang, into the hills west of the city.
heroCaption: The Golden Bridge, held by the stone hands

notice.title: The basic ticket is not every ride
notice.body: The cable car, the Golden Bridge, the French Village, and Fantasy Park are on the basic ticket. The wine cellar, the light area, the toboggan, climbing, and the cinema are extra.

body: Ride the cable car up from the foot of the hill and walk the Golden Bridge, the span the stone hands hold out over the valley. The same basic ticket covers the French Village and Fantasy Park. This is a built hill resort. The visit is the cable car, the bridge, and the village on the hill.
The hill sits at about 20°C, cooler than the beach. Give the resort a day of its own. Skip it when the beach and Hoi An already have your nights.
A one-day ticket can be upgraded at the ticket office to three consecutive days, if you register before the first entry. Buffet combos and a night ticket are separate from the basic price.

figures.caption: The bridge at the end of the day, with the coast behind the hands
figures.alt: The Golden Bridge at sunset, held by stone hands above the hills west of Da Nang

gettingThere: The resort is in Ba Na commune, in the hills west of Da Nang. Go by car from the river or from My Khe. It is a hill drive, so set out in the morning and keep the day for the resort.

legs.heading: From Da Nang
legs.body: By car from the river, My Khe, or the airport, west into the hills.

legs.heading: Night combo shuttle
legs.body: The night combo, separate from the basic ticket, includes a shuttle from the 2/9 Monument waiting area at 14:00. Return buses leave at 20:30, 21:30, and 22:30.

hours: 08:00 to 22:00. Drive time from Da Nang: check on arrival.
closed: No weekly closing day is published. Check the operator’s daily board on arrival.
admissionNote: Non-resident adult 1,000,000 VND. A visitor over 70, and a child from 1 m to under 1.4 m, 800,000 VND. Under 1 m free. A child over 1.4 m pays the adult price. A Da Nang resident adult pays 650,000 VND, and a resident senior or a resident child in that height band pays 550,000 VND. The city tourism list and the operator’s 2026 price page give the same basic prices. The basic ticket includes the round-trip cable car, the Golden Bridge, the French Village, and Fantasy Park. The wine cellar, the light area, the toboggan, climbing, and the cinema are extra.
